object_description: four articulated wings radiating around a central courtyard
design_condition: The radiating building addresses the full site perimeter, distributes access from multiple sides, and extends into a sequence of green and mineral intermediate spaces reaching rue du Parc.

positive.statement: The radiating device breaks up the imposing volume of the new college.

position.rationale: Four articulated wings visibly reduce the perceived scale of the overall college mass.

positive.statement: The spatial configuration favors multilateral access to the building.

position.rationale: The perimeter-facing plan supports access from multiple sides, though individual entrances are not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The exterior developments skillfully continue the system through successive intermediate zones.

position.rationale: The outer edge and articulated footprint provide a plausible anchor for successive landscape and mineral zones.

positive.statement: The ground-floor reference space effectively organizes the main public functions.

position.rationale: A ground-level anchor is placed along the lower articulated wing associated with public organization.

positive.statement: The spatial quality offered by the floor plan is undeniable.

position.target: spatial quality of the floor plan
position.rationale: The central courtyard and radiating configuration visibly organize the plan around a strong spatial core.

positive.statement: The facades provide a unified reading of the college and express its institutional character.

position.rationale: Continuous outer facade lines across the wings support a unified institutional reading.

positive.statement: The materialization gives the project a delicate and elegant character.

position.rationale: The south-east external facade provides the closest visible anchor for the expressed material character.

negative.statement: Typical classrooms facing the interior courtyard and entirely glazed create a usage problem for users.

position.rationale: The central courtyard and visibly articulated inner edges anchor the concern about glazed classroom fronts.

negative.statement: The use of the passageways and the interior staircase did not convince the jury.

position.rationale: Interior circulation is not directly resolved, so the estimate is constrained near the central connector zone.
